kill_reasons.W13-P1-G-002: Expected-yes restatement of a repeatedly documented artifact: batch-statistics dependence of batch-norm-era TTA and its collapse at batch size one is, to this judge's UNVERIFIED recall, the stated motivation of the single-sample/episodic TTA sub-literature. The residual (a unified batch-size scaling curve as primary axis) is measurement detail; the batch-size axis survives inside kept G-085's arrival-process rig. Independent convergence: Judge B's only kill. Recoverable via GATE-8 if the prior-art assessment fails.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-G-025: The record itself concedes 'the competitiveness of plain training is known' — the one-liner restates the famous ERM-matches-DG-algorithms result under fair model selection (UNVERIFIED recall). The residual (algorithm effect as a decreasing function of backbone quality) is an incremental scaling ablation and survives inside kept G-026's backbone-vs-algorithm variance decomposition. NOTE FOR CONSOLIDATOR: Judge B used G-025 as a merge PRIMARY (G-026->G-025); if this kill is upheld, G-026 is the surviving primary. Recoverable.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-G-068: Restates the published weight-averaging robustness-recovery family (weight-space ensembling of fine-tuned models recovering robustness lost to fine-tuning; model-soup-style averaging) as if contrarian — UNVERIFIED recall. The community belief it attacks ('averaging is an orthogonal trick') is not genuinely held; averaging is already the incumbent. Residual = a budget-matched frontier protocol, i.e. measurement detail. Recoverable.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-J-090: The record concedes the zero-terminal-SNR flaw is published; the published work already quantified the brightness/mean-shift artifact and shipped fixes (UNVERIFIED recall). Residual = auditing whether deployed models patched it — an expected-yes audit of a known, already-corrected flaw. Third instance of the wave's 'known-flaw-as-law' pattern. Judge B kept it on the cheap-kill honor roll — divergence recorded. Recoverable.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-J-091: The record concedes resolution-dependent schedule adjustments exist as engineering patches; to this judge's UNVERIFIED recall, derived (information/spectral-matching) resolution corrections to noise schedules are also published, not just folk patches. Residual = behavioral-invariance validation of a known rule. Recoverable.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-J-099: Expected-yes permutation: attention-swap editing is established for images (the record concedes this) and, to this judge's UNVERIFIED recall, training-free motion transfer by temporal-attention state injection is published for video diffusion. Residual = separability quantification, which is measurement detail on a demonstrated capability. Recoverable.

anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-027: Constructive rescue inside a debunk shard: invariance methods fail because annotated environments are not causally meaningful, and metadata-built environments revive them. Tension partner of G-026.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-048: Reframes augmentation as an unacknowledged train-time distribution shift interacting with test-time shift — a mechanism nobody in the shard's eval-critique mass touches.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-050: Performativity: deployed models reshape their own future data, breaking i.i.d. evaluation in a way only simulation protocols can measure. No template family; protect.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-058: Time-travel evaluation on post-cutoff imagery as the only clean novelty-robustness measurement. Instrument-defining; protect from coverage-family consolidation (it is the family's decisive test).
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-061: Contrarian sign-flip: foundation models LESS robust than small supervised models on low-level sensor/compression shifts — attacks the shard's own robustness-optimism and the field's.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-067: Instruction tuning / preference alignment as an unmeasured robustness tax on VLM visual competence — new axis, safety-relevant.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-077: Adversarially-filtered test sets measure disagreement with the filter model, making robustness conclusions filter-relative artifacts. Sharp, protocol-level, non-template.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-088: Anti-debunk: theory bounds are numerically vacuous yet ordinally predictive — rescues theory as a ranking tool. Genre-diversifying; Judge B folded it into G-087, this judge protects it (divergence recorded).
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-096: The text tower has its own distribution-shift problem (register, dialect, terminology) as large as image shift and unmeasured — genuinely new benchmark axis.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-G-097: Accuracy degrades gracefully while grounding collapses: language priors silently replace vision under shift. Distinct hidden-failure-swap mechanism.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-008: Era claim: dominant real-world degradations are now neural-network-induced (on-device enhancement), making classic degradation models obsolete. Field-redefining if true.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-009: Category-error claim: much low-quality imagery was never downsampled, so SR-as-inverse-downsampling is the wrong problem statement for a large share of use.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-013: Benchmark-incentive mechanism (alignment error rewards hedged blur) that explains a known aesthetic pathology; absorbs H-027.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-025: Psychophysics: preference between faithful and hallucinated restorations reverses with viewing time and ground-truth knowledge — time-limited studies structurally favor hallucination.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-026: Attacks the perception-distortion frontier itself as a loss mis-specification artifact, claiming a properly specified conditional likelihood dominates both endpoints. High-risk high-reward contrarian.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-042: Generative restorers as unstable inverse maps: imperceptible input perturbations flip hallucinated semantic content — forensic-grade failure, non-template.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-049: Mechanism inversion: SSL invariances are exactly what a fidelity metric must not have, so SSL features make WORSE perceptual losses than older supervised features.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-052: In-context restoration examples act as style anchors, not degradation evidence — shuffled examples work; attribution claim about an interface everyone trusts.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-069: Restorers exploit content-degradation correlation as a shortcut and misrestore counterfactual images — a causal-confound claim unique in the shard.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-076: Multi-frame video SR advantage collapses on properly anti-aliased/compressed footage because temporal aliasing is the main cross-frame cue — mechanism discovery with deployment consequences.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-080: Face-video enhancement alters lip/expression micro-motion, changing perceived speech and emotion — safety-relevant, invisible to every current metric.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-085: Natural-photo priors contaminate scientific imagery with plausible artifacts — hard-domain coupling claim; protect for the underserved-domains agenda.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-090: Face enhancement shifts identity-verification scores asymmetrically across demographic groups — fairness-relevant disparate-impact mechanism; protect.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-H-094: SR gets amplitude spectra right but phase systematically wrong, and phase error predicts perceived structural artifacts — crisp, subject-native, non-template.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-003: Prediction-parameterization (v/x0 vs epsilon) as the controller of high-noise feature quality — a concrete, checkable design-choice law.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-006: Null-prompted conditional models beat genuinely unconditional ones: text conditioning organizes representations even when unused — surprising if true.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-023: Un-negatable concepts: score-subtraction negation removes appearance but cannot remove relational content — a predicted CLASS of failures, not an instance.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-036: Inverted latents carry a recoverable fingerprint of the caption used at inversion — forensic and bias implications; non-template.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-043: Layout-tier memorization: composition templates recur far above verbatim copying — a second, unmeasured tier of memorization; anchor of the memorization cell.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-052: Seed as composition genome with a searchable layout library — folklore turned into a falsifiable mapping (+ absorbed J-053 steering arm).
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-058: Provable under-dispersion of diffusion posterior samplers in controlled linear inverse problems, with a correction factor — theory-grade and deployment-relevant.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-067: Language as a hidden conditioning variable: same concept in different languages yields systematically different visual distributions — cultural-prior quantification.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-079: One-step generators are qualitatively different objects: discontinuity at the 1-to-2 step transition locates the boundary of diffusion-like behavior.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-082: VAE decoders hallucinate texture deterministically — decoder-signature textures and unrepresentable true textures; underpins forensic and eval claims.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-086: Shared-VAE ecosystem correlates errors across 'independent' models, deflating ensemble gains — supply-chain claim mirroring accepted F-060's spirit at the architecture level.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-088: Coarse-to-fine generation is a property of Gaussian schedules, not diffusion itself — corruption-operator counterfactual with representation-learning consequences.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-096: Video diffusion buys smoothness by suppressing motion diversity — lawful under-dispersion of motion statistics; measurable and consequential.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-J-104: Video models memorize at LOWER duplication thresholds than image models because temporal redundancy is built-in duplication — privacy intuitions ported from images are wrong.

deliberate_tensions_kept.tension: Cross-seed dispersion as a hallucination map (H-030) vs agreement-can-be-confidently-wrong with an uncalibrated agreement-accuracy relation (H-039), with J-062 claiming the coupling collapses under shift. One calibration study adjudicates; kept unmerged deliberately.

Opposite predictions from one instrument: gen_j claims sampler dispersion localizes at genuinely ill-posed structure (J-056/J-057); gen_h claims seed diversity is misallocated — varying irrelevant texture while collapsing on ambiguous content (H-037). Substrate differs (dense prediction vs restoration); the disagreement is experiment-adjudicable and protected.

Three incompatible mechanisms for long-horizon adaptation stability: periodic hard reset (G-011) vs cached per-condition domain memory (G-079) vs divergence anchor to source (G-082). A single long-stream benchmark ranks them; merging would destroy the disagreement.

Is algorithm-centric DG research dead (G-026: rankings are backbone noise) or mis-tested (G-027: works given causally meaningful environments)? Kept as the shard's productive argument, sharpened now that G-025 is killed.

Does multi-step generative machinery pay off outside sampling? H-099 says single-pass matches multi-step for restoration at matched compute; J-019/J-013 claim distilled/cheap variants retain most generative advantages for perception. Adjudicable by one matched-compute battery.

What should monitoring optimize — detection power on embeddings (G-037), anytime-valid false-alarm control (G-042), or harm-calibrated alarms (G-038, which says most detected shifts are harmless)? Protocol-level disagreement kept.
